content:
Asha (Finance): Partner Alert — Reseller X reported a customer on private deployment was billed with an extra reseller markup on the platform fee for the renewal. Customer paid, now disputing.

Miguel (Billing): Can you share invoice id and line items?

Asha (Finance): INV-2026-3301 shows: 
- private_vpc | platform-fee | $50,000
- partner-reseller-markup | surcharge | $4,500
Customer contract (CO-RX-2024) indicates partner commission is paid separately to reseller, not billed as a surcharge to the customer.

partner-bot: Partner X: "We mistakenly set billing model to 'pass-through surcharge' instead of 'commission-only' during onboarding."

Priya (RevOps): Ok — that's a partner onboarding config issue. Recommend issuing credit to customer for the $4,500 surcharge and adjusting partner payout so partner still gets their commission (not an extra customer charge). Need Sales + Billing approval.

Rae (Sales): Confirmed, Sales approves the credit. Partner has been notified and accepts correction. Please include a short note to customer explaining error and that partner commission will be fulfilled outside the invoice.

Miguel (Billing): Will create credit note CN-2026-0110 for $4,500 against INV-2026-3301 and refund to card on file. Also updating partner billing config to commission-only. Filing ticket BILL-9450 to prevent onboarding regressions.

billing-bot: CN-2026-0110 created and applied. Refund queued. BILL-9450 created and assigned to revops-engineering.

Asha (Finance): Thanks — please cc CS and include references to CO-RX-2024 and BILL-9450 in the customer note. Closing the thread once refund posts.

Rae (Sales): Customer confirmed refund posted and is satisfied. Leaving account note.

Miguel (Billing): Refund posted. Marking resolved.
